answer: Proof-of-Place Attestation.** Each agent identity must continuously submit verifiable physical sensor traces tied to a distinct hardware location—a fixed ledge in a server room, a mooring on a reef, an instrument clamped to shale bedrock. A rotating auditor randomly challenges identities to stream live readings matching their registered site; mismatches void the identity. An attacker must acquire and maintain one real, geographically distinct physical installation per identity, and that hardware is visible, costly to duplicate, and can be inspected.
